abstract: Teratomas of gastric origin are rare. We are aware of 90 such tumors having previously been reported, all of which have been benign and only three of which have arisen in females. We report a gastric teratoma that presented as an exophytic gastric tumor in an 8-week-old female, the fourth such recorded tumor in a female neonate. Complete surgical excision was followed by clinical and biochemical surveillance without adjuvant treatment. At 1 year the patient was well without evidence of residual or recurrent disease. The child developed Hodgkin's disease 3 years later, and we believe this to be the first recorded association of these two tumors.
abstract_ja: 胃原発の奇形腫は稀である。著者らは、生後8週の女児に外向性の胃腫瘍として発生した奇形腫を報告する。女性新生児における4例目の記録である。完全外科切除の後、補助療法は行わずに臨床的および生化学的な経過観察を行った。1年後には残存または再発病変はなく、良好な経過であった。その3年後にホジキン病を発症し、我々の知る限り、これら2つの腫瘍の関連が報告されたのは初めてである。
